value.hook: Review worktrees have no node_modules; signal probes need job control
value.title: Testing shell scripts from a review worktree

sections.name: body
sections.value: 1) A detached review worktree has no node_modules and must stay read-only. Copy the script, its test, nice19.sh, vitest.config.ts and package.json into a private mktemp -d, symlink node_modules to the main checkout's, then run harness/scripts/nice19.sh node_modules/.bin/vitest run <file>. Delete that dir by its exact path afterwards (F262). 2) To probe a script's INT trap, start it with set -m and exec, so $! is the script itself and INT is not ignored: a background job in a non-interactive shell ignores INT, and a wrapper subshell takes the signal instead of the script. The CLI's kill guard needs a numeric pid, so put the probe in a file and use kill -s SIG "$pid". 3) Bash relays (while read; printf) are worth mutation-checking for status preservation; #337's tests did not cover it. Under macOS bash 3.2, a builtin printf to a closed FIFO leaks its buffered line to stdout later.
